invariants.rationale: The method always returns a Map, and a non-null return is expected unless explicitly returned as null, which is not shown in the implementation.
The input writeResult is required to call getWriteStatuses, so it must be non-null at this point.
If there are WriteStatus entries, then there should be at least one partition, hence result is not empty if and only if getWriteStatuses is not empty.
All distinct partition paths from write statuses should be covered as keys in the result map.
All mapped lists should be non-null since the mapping function always returns a Pair with a non-null List.
